title.value: Low-Rank Representation of Reinforcement Learning Policies
title.justification: The title was directly extracted from the paper's header.
title.quote: Low-Rank Representation of Reinforcement Learning Policies

extractions.description: The paper presents a framework for policy representation in reinforcement learning (RL) by embedding policies in a low-dimensional space using reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This approach offers theoretical guarantees on the expected returns of the policies and reduces variance without significant performance loss. The framework is evaluated on classic RL tasks, showing robust policy representation with reduced variance in expected returns.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on methods for improving reinforcement learning policies but does not directly address eco-responsible applications or efforts that align with specific environmental, climate, or sustainability goals.
primary_category.quote: We propose a general framework for policy representation for reinforcement learning tasks. This framework involves finding a low-dimensional embedding of the policy on a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS).

primary_sub_category.justification: The framework and results are primarily focused on theoretical and computational improvements in RL, and there's no direct application or mention of eco-responsible domains like renewable energy, agriculture, or any other listed category.
